d: Farewell to heaven made of waves full of moon rays and mysteries!-The night abandons the sky; - his life-giving work is finished; - men and things have rested and dreamed; - it surrenders the government of life to the day. As in a great veil of mists, everything floods a diaphanous and undecided tint; - it is the uncertainty of the first ray, but gradually then, behold! the first dawns that spread reflected in adamantine sparks within the dew on the flowers, on the herbs! - In the small garden of Iris, the flowers, as curious children, lift the faces from the corolla navels and look to the east. - The house of Iris is still closed inside its coloured mats and its oak doors. The village, behind that gray spot of tall, pale bamboos, still elevates undecided in the dusk its bizarre roofs; and the creek that divides it from the small house of Iris without purpose, mortis, gazing its glows, without cadence;

Where is now the humble little house of yours so modest and simple with its colorful mats and oak doors, or little Iris? - the white hedge of flowering hawthorns? - the path covered by the flower of the scrubs that leads to the river? -where is the peace of the fields around and the refreshing silence as the rest of your valley within the wide circular expanse of mountains and, above, the solemn majesty of Fousiyama? - where the pure air? - where the light frees? - You now lie in the breathtaking heart of the joyful city where the throbbing of the existences in the different fevers that stir the people - that of the glory, that of the pleasure, that of the money. - The most striking of the Green Houses is now your home: - you rest on the rise of lacquer and gold of a very rich fton, abandoned the fragile person to the fatigue that has crushed you, and covre a transparent veil like air! - You are in the Yowara - You are in the very sweet - You are in the Yowara!

O beautiful Japanese genius, beautiful and ancient genius of poetry, legends, fearful dramas, grotesque comedies and sweet ways to the loves that animate the silences of the evenings, - beautiful and ancient genius of flowers and painters, not gaiety of bright colors, not white lightnings of moons or expanses of green meadows current to the slopes of blue mountains reflected by white lakes, not triumphs of skies and flocks of migrants birds, or silver seas and agile awabis satettii, around the agony of Iris? On the delicate body, destroyed masterpiece, down in the abyss lies only the three sinister nights, the night without stars of the sky, - the night without reflections of the dead waters, the night without tears of the insensitivity of nature. So here dies the virgin, the petil body abandoned to the embrace of the poisonous bomhêria and of the punishi.
